label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

cached.description: True when the link was already known and answered instantly.

costUsd.description: What this call charged (the flat price).

deferred.description: True for first-ever media links (transcription runs 2-8 minutes). Poll statusUrl until knowledgeReady, then GET markdownUrl.

kind.description: Content type: article, video, or podcast.

knowledgeReady.description: True when `packet` is present — answer directly from it, no second fetch.

markdownUrl.description: The knowledge packet as raw markdown.

packet.description: Token-efficient markdown knowledge packet: title, summary, key claims and facts with citations, plus pointers to full text, graded evidence, and timestamped transcript files.

runId.description: Durable id of the knowledge page.

status.description: succeeded for instant answers; running/queued while a first-ever link processes.

statusUrl.description: Public JSON status endpoint for deferred runs — no auth needed.

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
